name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life

name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment

name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]

name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul

name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him]

name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: And enter among My [righteous] servants

name: Al-Fajr · الفجر
en: And enter My Paradise

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: I swear by this city, Makkah

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: We have certainly created man into hardship

name: Al-Balad · البلد
ar: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: Does he think that no one has seen him

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: Have We not made for him two eyes

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: And a tongue and two lips

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: And have shown him the two ways

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: It is the freeing of a slave

name: Al-Balad · البلد
ar: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: An orphan of near relationship

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: Or a needy person in misery

name: Al-Balad · البلد
ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: Those are the companions of the right

name: Al-Balad · البلد
ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left

name: Al-Balad · البلد
en: Over them will be fire closed in
